name: pwr_state_8002
meaning: byte mirrored at EEPROM 0xFFFE, saved from NMI path

name: boot_marker2
meaning: EEPROM 0x10010 marker of the A2 device

name: usb_ep3_status0
meaning: USB EP3 report byte 0 (1 = audio free)

name: mem_attr
meaning: per-slot memory attribute bytes (EEPROM 0x2940); b0-1==3 valid, b6 bank, b7 skip

name: io_ddr_shadow
meaning: shadow of write-only DDR FFFBA8 (I2C SDA dir)

name: ui_refresh_flags
meaning: b0 = edit side B, b1 = redraw request, b2 = S-meter restart

name: bandA_rec_ptr
meaning: pointer to live band-A operating record

name: settings_R2
meaning: settings region R2 (EEPROM 0xC000); byte 0 = APRS/data on B (tested in 3EEEE)

name: settings_R3
meaning: settings region R3 (EEPROM 0xD000); FF8D20 band-A comm mode

name: band_sel
meaning: b6 band B selected, b7 single-band view, b5/b3 pending flags; head of mirrored block 0

name: band_slot_chk
meaning: b0 band-B record in use; b0/b1 dual receive

name: u16tab_A
meaning: u16 table cache side A (B: FF8790, C: FF8858)

name: def_ctcss
meaning: default CTCSS index for synthesised channels

name: smeter_timer_A
meaning: S-meter update divider band A (B: FF9581)

name: rtc_int_hist
meaning: shift history of FFFF45.b3 (RTC INT) for edge detect

name: audio_req
meaning: audio route request byte (b4 force session, 0x2C TX bits)

name: dtmf_flags
meaning: b0 string, b1 manual key, b6 active

name: scan_wrapped
meaning: 0xFF when slot stepping wrapped to start

name: dsp_dtmf_code
meaning: DTMF code mailbox for DSP (d+1, 0xFE off, 0xFF idle)

name: vfo_bak_invalid
meaning: bit n = backup of block n invalid

name: shadow0
meaning: last-saved copy of block 0 (also 1: BCF6, 2: BD76, 3: BDF6)

name: dgid_hdr
meaning: DG-ID cache 0x1A000 (0x1200 set + band VFO A/B)

name: flags_AA31
meaning: b4 force regular area, b5 VFO shadows valid

name: P_DR
meaning: I2C port data: b0 SDA, b1 SCL

name: P5D_DR
meaning: b4 RTC data out, b5 RTC chip enable
